t: Single-pack barrier coating for above ground use. Effective against water, vapour, CO2, methane and radon. Supplied ready-to-use with a consistency similar to that of thick emulsion paint. Once applied, the product cures to form a membrane that is flexible and elastic. Water-based and can be applied to damp substrates by brush, roller or spray. The applied product is typically touch-dry in one hour. Applied in two coats.
b: For Solid Floors, Embedded Timbers & Walls
